# teams_tenant_federation_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing TenantFederationConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allow_federated_users` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowFederatedUsers parameter.
- `allow_teams_consumer` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowTeamsConsumer parameter.
- `allow_teams_consumer_inbound` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowTeamsConsumerInbound parameter.
- `allowed_domains` (String) Maps to the -AllowedDomains parameter.
- `allowed_domains_as_a_list` (String) Maps to the -AllowedDomainsAsAList parameter.
- `allowed_trial_tenant_domains` (String) Maps to the -AllowedTrialTenantDomains parameter.
- `block_all_subdomains` (Boolean) Maps to the -BlockAllSubdomains parameter.
- `blocked_domains` (String) Maps to the -BlockedDomains parameter.
- `enable_external_access_restrictions_for_chat_participants` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableExternalAccessRestrictionsForChatParticipants parameter.
- `enable_mutual_federation_for_chat_participants` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableMutualFederationForChatParticipants parameter.
- `external_access_with_trial_tenants` (String) Maps to the -ExternalAccessWithTrialTenants parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `restrict_teams_consumer_to_external_user_profiles` (Boolean) Maps to the -RestrictTeamsConsumerToExternalUserProfiles parameter.
- `security_team_allow_block_list_delegation` (String) Maps to the -SecurityTeamAllowBlockListDelegation parameter.
- `shared_sip_address_space` (Boolean) Maps to the -SharedSipAddressSpace parameter.
- `treat_discovered_partners_as_unverified` (Boolean) Maps to the -TreatDiscoveredPartnersAsUnverified parameter.
